source.job_page_title: Software Development Engineer II, International Emerging Stores Sub-same Day

job_description.summary: The Sub-Same-Day (SSD) team builds technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery promises across India and emerging marketplaces. The role focuses on services that compute and optimize the fastest reliable delivery promise for each order, with high scale, low latency, and high availability.
responsibilities: Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency, highly available services that power Sub-Same-Day delivery promises.
Own features end-to-end across requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
Lead design discussions and align with partner teams, including Promise, transportation, and search.
Maintain operational excellence through monitoring, alarms, on-call, and defect reduction.
Investigate edge cases, improve testing, and support safe production rollouts using canaries, metrics, and dashboards.
Identify and mitigate risks and communicate progress, blockers, and tradeoffs.
Mentor SDE-I engineers, review code and designs, and help unblock junior engineers.
Contribute to the team's technical roadmap and continuous improvement.
basic_qualifications: At least 3 years of non-internship professional software development experience.
At least 2 years of non-internship design or architecture experience involving design patterns, reliability, and scaling.
At least 1 year of software development engineer or related occupational experience.
At least 1 year designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded, or distributed applications, tools, systems, or services using C#, C++, Java, or Perl.
At least 1 year of object-oriented design experience.
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
preferred_qualifications: At least 3 years across the software development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing, and operations experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
